analyst_view.overall: Early view: PSV host Go Ahead Eagles four days after visiting Real Madrid in the Champions League. PSV beat Willem II 7-0 and Cambuur 5-2 in their last two league games with Mijnans in hat-trick form, but Go Ahead's last two wins were 1-0 with Cillessen keeping clean sheets and Tengstedt scoring, even if they also lost 4-0 at Cambuur.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.4 goals. I lean lower: Go Ahead's last two wins were 1-0 with Cillessen in form, and PSV usually rotate after a midweek game, which has cost them points this season. The 4-0 loss at Cambuur shows Go Ahead can still collapse, so three or four goals remains the likely range.

corners.text: The numbers say 11 corners, mostly PSV's. Go Ahead will defend deep at the Philips Stadion and PSV's wide play fits the estimate.

cards.text: The numbers say 2.6 cards. No rivalry, no bans in the news and a probably dominant home side; I keep it.

shots.text: The numbers say 34.1 shots. PSV's attacking volume at home justifies a high figure even with rotation, and Go Ahead will mostly look to counter through Tengstedt.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 11.9 shots on target. With Cillessen in form and a rotated PSV attack, I lean slightly lower.
